name: Grandfather Karlov
description: Teysa's ghostly grandfather, killed by Kaya along with the Obzedat.

description_citations.text: "Teysa Karlov". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teysa's coup with Tajic against the Obzedat is foiled by her ghostly grandfather, and the Ghost Council strips her of her offices.
timeline.quote: she was foiled by her ghostly grandfather and stripped of her office of advokist and grand envoy by the Ghost Council.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Staging a coup". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya, sent by Bolas, infiltrates the catacombs and kills Grandfather Karlov and the Obzedat, becoming the new Orzhov leader; Teysa is reinstated as leading oligarch.
timeline.quote: Kaya infiltrated the catacombs and killed Grandfather Karlov and all other members of the Obzedat.
